practice.title: Math guided practice · Measurement and cumulative review

items.prompt: A rectangle is 12 cm by 4 cm. Find its perimeter.
items.answer: 32 cm

items.prompt: A rectangle has area 36 square cm and width 4 cm. Find its length.
items.answer: 9 cm

items.prompt: Two rectangles are 3 by 8 cm and 4 by 6 cm. Compare their areas and perimeters.
items.answer: Both areas are 24 square cm. Perimeters are 22 cm and 20 cm; equal area does not guarantee equal perimeter.

practice.title: Science
contexts: W4 data: A fictional class compares water collection in two labeled trials using the same time interval. Trial A: 14 milliliters of water collected; Trial B: 22 milliliters of water collected. These are invented assessment data, not a claim about a real investigation.

items.prompt: Use W4 data. Which trial has the higher recorded value, and by how much?
items.answer: Trial B; 8 milliliters of water collected.

items.prompt: Use W4 data. State one observation without claiming its cause.
items.answer: Trial B recorded 22 versus 14 in A; accept an accurate description without an unsupported causal claim.

practice.title: Art
practice.passage: Presentation provides context and clear explanation. Reflection identifies growth, limits, and goals. Credit collaborators and borrowed material.

items.prompt: What belongs in thoughtful reflection?
items.answer: Evidence of choices, learning, limitations, and a next goal.

items.prompt: Present selected work or adapted performance with a strength, limitation, and next step. Use a labeled drawing and 3-5 sentences.

items.prompt: What should a critical-thinking portfolio demonstrate?

items.prompt: Select two pieces showing improvement and present a respectful explanation of your reasoning. Use a labeled drawing and 3-5 sentences.
items.answer: Look for a relevant completed activity, an accurate concept, evidence or an example, and a reasoned explanation/revision. Accept varied justified responses. Do not grade beliefs or private experiences.

items.prompt: A prism has base area 18 square cm and height 5 cm. Volume?
items.answer: 90 cubic cm

items.prompt: A prism has volume 60 cubic cm and base area 12 square cm. Height?
items.answer: 5 cm

items.prompt: Explain the difference between surface area and volume for a closed box.
items.answer: Surface area measures outer faces in square units (wrapping); volume measures interior space in cubic units (filling). Both distinctions required.
